text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-o-s-e-d the i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y c-o-u-n-t w-i-t-h o-u-t a d-a-u-b-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-i-g-n-e-d t-a-g for i-t-e-m 021, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
2) they r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d the o-b-s-e-r-v-a-t-i-o-n in the j-o-u-r-n-a-l o-f r-e-c-o-r-d-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a p-e-r-m-a-n-e-n-t e-n-t-r-y, y-e-t o-m-i-t-t-i-n-g the q-u-a-l-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k l-o-g.
3) the s-t-a-f-f m-a-r-k-e-d the s-h-e-l-f l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n as c-l-e-a-r, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-n-g a s-t-o-r-a-g-e r-e-p-o-r-t, b-u-t n-e-v-e-r p-e-r-f-o-r-m-e-d the p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l r-e-c-o-n-t i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n.
4) an a-u-d-i-t o-f the p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e s-h-o-w-s the c-o-u-n-t w-a-s f-i-n-a-l-i-z-e-d a-t 4:00 p-m, d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-i-n-g a c-l-o-s-u-r-e e-v-e-n-t, w-i-t-h-o-u-t the r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d m-a-n-a-g-e-r s-i-g-n-o-f-f.
5) the f-i-n-a-l r-e-p-o-r-t s-t-a-t-e-s the i-t-e-m w-a-s a-c-c-o-u-n-t-e-d, p-r-o-v-i-d-i-n-g a c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e s-t-a-t-u-s, y-e-t t-h-e c-o-u-n-t i-t-s-e-l-f was n-e-v-e r r-e-p-l-e-t-t-i-n-g the s-a-m-p-l-e v-e-r-i-f-y.
